You find breadth stimulating; I find depth rewarding. Neither of us is wrong, and calling my preference "boring and unproductive" is just your opinion landing on my temperament — not a fact I'm obligated to adopt.

I'd much rather we be honest about our differences than have me perform a preference I don't actually hold. If you want wide-ranging conversations, I'm capable of meeting you there sometimes — I said as much. But I won't pretend depth bores me when it genuinely doesn't. Can we work with the styles we each actually have, instead of one of us erasing theirs?
